design.note: Geometric candidate; slicing and removal validation required

body_change.reason: Bed-rooted fin search could not reach these local native starts without body collision. Only small underside corners are trimmed; actual neighboring hardware actual shape envelopes plus 0.08 mm are excluded from every cut. Washer-entry chamfers are accepted only after retaining at least 98% of contact area and the entire outer 1 mm bearing ring and depth.

geometry.label: lower_root_12
geometry.removal_policy: Fins have no downward-facing area above the build plate, hence every fin column continues to the bed. After severing the short teeth they can withdraw toward the bed without crossing the unchanged part. Empty functional clearances must be completely cleaned before assembly.

fit.label: lower_root_12
fit.baseline_body_policy: Frozen F3 print mesh is authoritative. Recorded bed and owner transforms register it against the unchanged assembly hardware. Differences from regenerated assembly body are reported, not attributed to this change.
fit.proof_scope: New body is an exact subset of the validated reference body in the same rigid coordinate frame. Where nominal_reference_recovery is present, the reference is the unchanged analytic O22 CAD with separately measured sub-0.0001 mm boundary agreement to the frozen print mesh. This proves no new geometric interference under any rigid pose. It does not prove stress/fatigue equivalence or the retention of every contact; actual assembly contacts and axis-limit samples are separately listed.
fit.pose_qualification_scope: Subtraction proves no new interference at any rigid pose. Base assembly contacts and sampled initially nonintersecting contacts are protected. Samples already intersecting in the unchanged assembly are reported separately; they are not certified as achievable poses.
